description: Animate items: motion preset, events (page load, page click, self click, self roll over), duration, plays and loop, speed, animate from/to current appearance, rotate, origin, scale, opacity, visibility, and a motion path drawn as points or converted from a path (Animation panel)

animate.description: Animate: from current appearance, to current appearance, or to current location

events.description: Event(s) that play the animation: On Page Load, On Page Click, On Click (Self), On Roll Over (Self); replaces the current ones (On Button Event: use add_button_action with action animation)

keepPath.description: With motionPathFrom: keep the path item (it is deleted by default, as the panel command does)

motionPath.description: Motion path through these [x, y] points (mm from the top-left of the item's page)

motionPathFrom.description: Convert to Motion Path: the id of a path (line, polygon...) whose shape becomes the motion path

opacity.description: Opacity: none, fade in or fade out

origin.description: Origin (the reference point) of rotation and scaling

preset.description: Motion preset name, e.g. "fly-in-left" (see manage_motion_presets list)

remove.description: Remove the animation (Animation panel > Remove); combine with nothing else

reverseOnRollOff.description: With ON_SELF_ROLLOVER: reverse on roll off

rotate.description: Rotate by this many degrees over the animation

scale.description: Scale to these percentages over the animation (one left out stays 100)

speed.description: Speed: none (constant), ease in, ease out, ease in and out

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: set_animation
title: Set Animation
